Widget Pro Jewelry Subscription

Get a professional‑grade jewelry calculator on your site without the hassle. The subscription gives you a widget that looks like yours, no branding, and sends inquiries straight to you.

How it works for a jewelry retailer

  1. Sign up for the $12/month plan at the Widget Pro Jewelry Subscription page.
  2. Add the provided code to your product pages.
  3. Customers use the calculator to estimate diamond, gold, or gemstone value.
  4. When they click “Get a quote,” the request lands in your inbox, ready for follow‑up.

What you get / cost

  • Monthly fee: $12 per domain
  • No attribution line on the widget
  • Custom call‑to‑action button that directs inquiries to you
  • Unlimited usage on your site
  • No account creation or data storage on CaratBase

FAQ

Question? *Does the widget require a user account?* No. The widget runs entirely on your site; users never create an account.

Question? *Can I change the look of the widget?* Yes. The code can be styled with your CSS to match your brand.

Question? *What happens after a customer submits a request?* The inquiry is sent directly to the email address you set in the widget settings.

Start your Widget Pro subscription today
